visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair tied back stands in a brightly lit hotel bathroom, wearing a blue and white tie-dye yukata. She holds a smartphone with a character-themed case for a mirror selfie. Next, a close-up shows a grey stone hot spring tub with steam rising; a wooden tray floats on top holding a bamboo bucket. White captions appear at the top center. (2) On a bustling night street, a food stall sign for '炸彈蔥油餅' is shown. A pair of hands in black gloves using metal tongs flips round dough balls that puff up like balloons in a large vat of bubbling hot oil. The background is dark with streetlights. (3) Inside a hotel room, the woman wears a white shirt and takes a large bite of a crispy fried pancake, revealing a runny yellow egg yolk inside. She chews with a satisfied expression. (4) A night shot of a glowing green '高記茶莊' sign is featured. The woman holds a large red paper cup and drinks through a straw. The setting is a cozy indoor space with warm ambient lighting. (5) Montage of hotel interiors including a modern, minimalist lobby with a large golden floral centerpiece and a bedroom with twin beds featuring white linens and light wood accents. The woman poses in a beige coat. (6) In a private stone bath, the woman soaks in the water, leaning her head against the edge while holding a green beverage can. Water flows from a modern stone spout. The lighting is dim and intimate. (7) Close-up shots of Aveeno bottles on a stone ledge. Hands press the pump of the body wash bottle, dispensing a cream-colored liquid. The woman applies the soap and lotion to her arms, creating white lather. The background is a clean wooden-textured wall. (8) The woman, now in a yellow t-shirt, poses with the bottles and a bundle of dried wheat stalks. She smiles, points at the products, and gives a thumbs-up. The video concludes with a shot of her relaxing in the hot spring tub.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female Mandarin narration begins instantly over a bright, rhythmic electronic pop track with a steady drum beat. A brief 'whoosh' sound effect marks a visual transition. The acoustics are crisp with high spectral brightness. (2) Sizzling sound effects of deep-frying are layered over the continuous BGM as the pancake is shown. The vocal tone is melodic and enthusiastic, with clear articulation. (3) A soft 'pop' sound effect occurs as text variety captions appear. The vocal energy remains high, describing food texture and taste with expressive pitch contours. (4) A mechanical 'click' and 'squish' sound occurs as the lotion bottle pump is pressed, synchronized with the visuals. Splashing water sounds are introduced softly during the bath scenes. (5) Bubbling SFX and 'ding' notification sounds highlight specific product benefits. The BGM remains consistent in its 4/4 driving tempo. (6) The narration concludes with a cheerful sign-off, followed by a slight swell in the music and a final hard cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Sequence of Events -> Product Demonstration -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Aveeno skincare products by integrating them into a relatable and aspirational lifestyle vlog about a weekend trip to a hot spring hotel.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed product demonstration, mention of brand name, and listed benefits with a call to action.
